Class ClientController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.mesos.network.ClientController
public class ClientController extends Object
Core controller of the client-side application. This class manages all actions that a client can perform within the game and acts as a bridge between the user interface (View) and the network layer (Network). It is designed to be independent of the specific implementations of both the view (CLI/GUI) and the network protocol (RMI/Socket), relying only on their common interfaces. The controller also maintains the latest state of the game and the client, allowing it to determine which actions are currently permitted.
